def configure_deterministic_development():
    """Apply after completed-source admission and before any CUDA context."""
    if torch.cuda.is_initialized():
        raise RuntimeError("Fresh development policy must precede CUDA initialization")
    os.environ["CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG"] = ":4096:8"
    torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True, warn_only=False)
    torch.backends.cudnn.benchmark = False
    torch.backends.cudnn.deterministic = True
    torch.set_float32_matmul_precision("highest")
    torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32 = False
    torch.backends.cudnn.allow_tf32 = False
    return deterministic_development_manifest()

def deterministic_development_manifest():
    result = deepcopy(DETERMINISTIC_POLICY)
    actual = {
        "cublas_workspace_config": os.environ.get("CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG"),
        "deterministic_algorithms": torch.are_deterministic_algorithms_enabled(),
        "warn_only": torch.is_deterministic_algorithms_warn_only_enabled(),
        "cudnn_benchmark": torch.backends.cudnn.benchmark,
        "cudnn_deterministic": torch.backends.cudnn.deterministic,
        "cuda_matmul_allow_tf32": torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32,
        "cudnn_allow_tf32": torch.backends.cudnn.allow_tf32,
        "float32_matmul_precision": torch.get_float32_matmul_precision(),
    }
    if any(actual[key] != result[key] for key in actual):
        raise RuntimeError("Fresh development deterministic execution policy drift")
    return result

def _layout(bank: LeafInterfaceBank, count: int) -> AnchorKernelLayout:
    if not isinstance(count, int) or count < 1:
        raise ValueError("num_anchors must be a positive integer")
    intervals, positions = bank.intervals.detach().double(), bank.positions.detach().double()
    if intervals.device.type != "cpu" or positions.device.type != "cpu":
        raise ValueError("Prepare anchor coordinates on CPU before transferring the bank")
    if intervals.ndim != 2 or intervals.shape[1] != 2 or intervals.shape[0] == 0 or positions.ndim != 1:
        raise ValueError("Require positive intervals and a fixed target-coordinate vector")
    if not bool(torch.isfinite(intervals).all()) or not bool(torch.isfinite(positions).all()):
        raise ValueError("Coordinates must be finite")
    order = torch.argsort(intervals[:, 0])
    sorted_intervals = intervals[order]
    if bool((sorted_intervals[:, 1] <= sorted_intervals[:, 0]).any()) or not torch.equal(sorted_intervals[:-1, 1], sorted_intervals[1:, 0]):
        raise ValueError("Intervals must form an exact positive contiguous tile")
    left, right = sorted_intervals[0, 0], sorted_intervals[-1, 1]
    if bank.window_bounds is not None and not torch.equal(bank.window_bounds.detach().cpu().double(), torch.stack((left, right))):
        raise ValueError("Supplied tile endpoints differ from exact interval coverage")
    if bool(((positions < left) | (positions >= right)).any()):
        raise ValueError("Readouts must lie within the half-open tile")
    anchor = left+(torch.arange(count, dtype=torch.float64)+.5)*((right-left)/count)
    if torch.unique(anchor).numel() != count or bool(((anchor <= left) | (anchor >= right)).any()):
        raise ValueError("Coordinate precision cannot represent the fixed midpoint anchors")
    width = ((right-left)/count).expand(count).clone()
    starts = sorted_intervals[:, 0].contiguous()
    anchor_rank = torch.searchsorted(starts, anchor, right=True)-1
    target_rank = torch.searchsorted(starts, positions, right=True)-1
    if bank.target_graph.shape != positions.shape or not torch.equal(bank.target_graph, order[target_rank]):
        raise ValueError("Target graph mapping differs from half-open containing intervals")
    evaluation = torch.unique(torch.cat((anchor, positions)), sorted=True)
    coordinates = torch.unique(torch.cat((sorted_intervals.flatten(), evaluation)), sorted=True)
    segment_rank = torch.searchsorted(starts, coordinates[:-1], right=True)-1
    segment_graph = order[segment_rank]
    durations = coordinates[1:]-coordinates[:-1]
    if bool((coordinates[1:] > sorted_intervals[segment_rank, 1]).any()):
        raise ValueError("A physical segment crosses an uncached graph hold")
    anchor_event = torch.searchsorted(coordinates, anchor)
    evaluation_event = torch.searchsorted(coordinates, evaluation)
    source_at_event = [-1]*len(coordinates)
    output_at_event = [-1]*len(coordinates)
    for p, event in enumerate(anchor_event.tolist()):
        source_at_event[event] = p
    for p, event in enumerate(evaluation_event.tolist()):
        output_at_event[event] = p
    return AnchorKernelLayout(anchor, width, order[anchor_rank], coordinates,
        segment_graph, durations, torch.searchsorted(evaluation, anchor),
        torch.searchsorted(evaluation, positions), tuple(source_at_event),
        tuple(output_at_event), len(evaluation))

def prepare_compact_anchor_layout_v1(intervals: Tensor, positions: Tensor, *,
        num_anchors: int = 32, target_graph: Tensor | None = None,
        window_bounds: Tensor | None = None) -> CompactAnchorLayoutV1:
    """Prepare CPU metadata, preserving the native fixed-anchor source measure."""
    if not isinstance(num_anchors, int) or num_anchors < 1:
        raise ValueError("num_anchors must be a positive integer")
    if intervals.device.type != "cpu" or positions.device.type != "cpu":
        raise ValueError("Prepare compact coordinate metadata on CPU")
    intervals, positions = intervals.detach().double(), positions.detach().double()
    if (intervals.ndim != 2 or intervals.shape[1] != 2 or not len(intervals)
            or positions.ndim != 1):
        raise ValueError("Require nonempty [G,2] intervals and [P] readouts")
    if not bool(torch.isfinite(intervals).all() & torch.isfinite(positions).all()):
        raise ValueError("Coordinates must be finite")
    order = torch.argsort(intervals[:, 0])
    holds = intervals[order]
    if (bool((holds[:, 1] <= holds[:, 0]).any())
            or not torch.equal(holds[:-1, 1], holds[1:, 0])):
        raise ValueError("Holds must be exactly positive and contiguous")
    left, right = holds[0, 0], holds[-1, 1]
    if window_bounds is not None:
        if (window_bounds.device.type != "cpu"
                or not torch.equal(window_bounds.detach().double(), torch.stack((left, right)))):
            raise ValueError("Window endpoints differ from exact hold coverage")
    if bool(((positions < left) | (positions >= right)).any()):
        raise ValueError("Readouts must be inside the half-open tile")
    anchors = left + (torch.arange(num_anchors, dtype=torch.float64) + .5) * (
        (right - left) / num_anchors)
    if (torch.unique(anchors).numel() != num_anchors
            or bool(((anchors <= left) | (anchors >= right)).any())):
        raise ValueError("Coordinate precision cannot represent midpoint anchors")
    weights = ((right - left) / num_anchors).expand(num_anchors).clone()
    starts = holds[:, 0].contiguous()
    anchor_graph = order[torch.searchsorted(starts, anchors, right=True) - 1]
    expected_target = order[torch.searchsorted(starts, positions, right=True) - 1]
    if target_graph is not None:
        if (target_graph.device.type != "cpu" or target_graph.dtype != torch.long
                or not torch.equal(target_graph, expected_target)):
            raise ValueError("Target graph differs from half-open physical mapping")
    evaluations = torch.unique(torch.cat((anchors, positions)), sorted=True)
    coordinates = torch.unique(torch.cat((holds.flatten(), anchors)), sorted=True)
    rank = torch.searchsorted(starts, coordinates[:-1], right=True) - 1
    segment_graph = order[rank]
    duration = coordinates[1:] - coordinates[:-1]
    if (bool((duration <= 0).any())
            or bool((coordinates[1:] > holds[rank, 1]).any())):
        raise ValueError("Compact segment crosses a supplied hold")
    evaluation_segment = torch.searchsorted(coordinates, evaluations, right=True) - 1
    evaluation_left = evaluations - coordinates[evaluation_segment]
    evaluation_right = coordinates[evaluation_segment + 1] - evaluations
    source_at_event = [-1] * len(coordinates)
    for anchor, event in enumerate(torch.searchsorted(coordinates, anchors).tolist()):
        source_at_event[event] = anchor
    groups = [[] for _ in range(len(duration))]
    for output, segment in enumerate(evaluation_segment.tolist()):
        groups[segment].append(output)
    if tuple(i for group in groups for i in group) != tuple(range(len(evaluations))):
        raise ValueError("Compact evaluation order is inconsistent")
    return CompactAnchorLayoutV1(
        anchors, weights, anchor_graph, evaluations,
        torch.searchsorted(evaluations, anchors),
        torch.searchsorted(evaluations, positions), coordinates,
        segment_graph, duration, evaluation_left, evaluation_right,
        tuple(source_at_event), tuple(segment_graph.tolist()),
        tuple(anchor_graph.tolist()), tuple(tuple(group) for group in groups),
        len(intervals))

def _state_project(state: Tensor, vectors: Tensor) -> Tensor:
    return (vectors.transpose(-1, -2) @ state.flatten(-2)).reshape_as(state)

source_excerpts.source_segment:
def _state_reconstruct(state: Tensor, vectors: Tensor) -> Tensor:
    return (vectors @ state.flatten(-2)).reshape_as(state)

source_excerpts.name: _readout_reconstruct_chunk
source_excerpts.source_segment:
def _readout_reconstruct_chunk(spectral: Tensor, vectors: Tensor) -> Tensor:
    """One U multiplication with readouts packed as columns, no repeated U.

    [B,S,Q,H,V] -> [S,Q,B*H*V] permits a single per-scale matrix product.
    A broadcast matmul with a [B,S,Q,Q] logical expansion is deliberately
    avoided because its implementation may materialize repeated bases.
    """
    b, s, q, h, v = spectral.shape
    packed = spectral.permute(1, 2, 0, 3, 4).reshape(s, q, b * h * v)
    physical = vectors @ packed
    return physical.reshape(s, q, b, h, v).permute(2, 0, 1, 3, 4)

source_excerpts.name: anchor_spectral_compact_action_v1
source_excerpts.source_segment:
def anchor_spectral_compact_action_v1(layout: CompactAnchorLayoutV1,
        geometry: CompactSpectralGeometryV1, sources: Tensor, rates: Tensor,
        damping: Tensor, *, coupling: str = "full",
        readout_chunk_size: int = 128) -> Tensor:
    """Exact real-arithmetic finite-anchor sum at unique evaluation positions.

    Sources [A,S,Q,H,V] bundle arbitrary numerator/mass components. Return
    [M,S,Q,H,V]. Forward includes each anchor self term and reverse excludes it.
    Fixed per-hold eigenpairs remain compact. Rate/source gradients use ordinary
    autograd through the compact scan and batched same-hold readouts.
    """
    if coupling not in {"full", "scalar", "diagonal", "gain_matched_diagonal"}:
        raise ValueError("Unknown compact kernel coupling")
    if not isinstance(readout_chunk_size, int) or readout_chunk_size < 1:
        raise ValueError("readout_chunk_size must be positive")
    if sources.ndim != 5:
        raise ValueError("Sources must be [A,S,Q,H,V]")
    a, s, q, h, v = sources.shape
    if (min(a, s, q, h, v) < 1 or a != len(layout.graph_at_anchor)
            or rates.shape != (s, h) or damping.shape != (s, h)
            or geometry.eigenvalues.shape != (layout.num_graphs, s, q)
            or geometry.eigenvectors.shape != (layout.num_graphs, s, q, q)):
        raise ValueError("Compact source/rate/geometry dimensions differ")
    if not sources.is_floating_point():
        raise ValueError("Sources must have floating dtype")
    tensors = (rates, damping, geometry.eigenvalues, geometry.eigenvectors)
    if any(x.device != sources.device or x.dtype != sources.dtype for x in tensors):
        raise ValueError("Source/rate/geometry device and dtype must match")
    if (layout.segment_duration.device != sources.device
            or layout.anchor_output.device != sources.device):
        raise ValueError("Transfer compact layout to the source device")
    fixed_fields = (geometry.eigenvalues, geometry.eigenvectors, geometry.cqr)
    if (any(x.requires_grad for x in fixed_fields)
            or (geometry.diagonal is not None and geometry.diagonal.requires_grad)):
        raise ValueError("Compact geometry must be fixed, without geometry gradients")
    flags = torch.stack((torch.isfinite(sources).all(), torch.isfinite(rates).all(),
                         torch.isfinite(damping).all(), (rates > 0).all(),
                         (damping > 0).all(), torch.isfinite(geometry.eigenvalues).all(),
                         torch.isfinite(geometry.eigenvectors).all()))
    if not bool(flags.all()):
        raise ValueError("Sources/fixed geometry and positive rates/damping must be finite")
    vectors = geometry.eigenvectors if coupling == "full" else None
    if coupling in {"diagonal", "gain_matched_diagonal"}:
        if (geometry.diagonal is None
                or geometry.diagonal.shape != geometry.eigenvalues.shape
                or geometry.diagonal.device != sources.device
                or geometry.diagonal.dtype != sources.dtype):
            raise ValueError("Diagonal controls require the matching fixed diagonal")
        values = geometry.diagonal
    elif coupling == "scalar":
        values = torch.ones_like(geometry.eigenvalues)
    else:
        values = geometry.eigenvalues
    decay = values[..., None] * rates[None, :, None, :] + damping[None, :, None, :]
    if not bool(torch.isfinite(decay).all() & (decay > 0).all()):
        raise ValueError("Compact decay must be finite and numerically positive")
    if coupling == "gain_matched_diagonal":
        full_decay = geometry.eigenvalues[..., None] * rates[None, :, None, :] + damping[None, :, None, :]
        if not bool(torch.isfinite(full_decay).all() & (full_decay > 0).all()):
            raise ValueError("Gain-matched full decay must be finite and positive")
        transformed = []
        for anchor, graph in enumerate(layout.graph_at_anchor):
            projected = _state_project(sources[anchor], geometry.eigenvectors[graph])
            equilibrium = _state_reconstruct(projected / full_decay[graph, ..., None],
                                             geometry.eigenvectors[graph])
            transformed.append(decay[graph, ..., None] * equilibrium)
        sources = torch.stack(transformed)
        if not bool(torch.isfinite(sources).all()):
            raise ValueError("Gain-matched sources overflowed")
    impulse = sources * layout.weights.to(sources.dtype)[:, None, None, None, None]
    projected_impulse = (torch.stack([_state_project(impulse[anchor], vectors[graph])
                          for anchor, graph in enumerate(layout.graph_at_anchor)])
                         if vectors is not None else impulse)
    factors = torch.exp(-layout.segment_duration.to(sources.dtype)[:, None, None, None]
                        * decay[layout.segment_graph])
    zero = sources.new_zeros((s, q, h, v))
    forward = []
    state = zero
    previous_graph = layout.graph_at_segment[0]
    for segment, graph in enumerate(layout.graph_at_segment):
        if vectors is not None and graph != previous_graph:
            state = _state_project(_state_reconstruct(state, vectors[previous_graph]), vectors[graph])
        source = layout.source_at_event[segment]
        if source >= 0:
            state = state + projected_impulse[source]
        forward.append(state)
        state = state * factors[segment, ..., None]
        previous_graph = graph
    backward = [zero] * layout.num_segments
    state = zero
    previous_graph = layout.graph_at_segment[-1]
    for segment in range(layout.num_segments - 1, -1, -1):
        graph = layout.graph_at_segment[segment]
        source = layout.source_at_event[segment + 1]
        # At a boundary the anchor belongs to the right-hand containing hold.
        # Include it before expressing the physical state in the left basis.
        if source >= 0:
            state = state + projected_impulse[source]
        if vectors is not None and graph != previous_graph:
            state = _state_project(_state_reconstruct(state, vectors[previous_graph]), vectors[graph])
        backward[segment] = state
        state = state * factors[segment, ..., None]
        previous_graph = graph
    chunks = []
    for segment, (graph, outputs) in enumerate(zip(layout.graph_at_segment,
                                                  layout.evaluation_at_segment)):
        for start in range(0, len(outputs), readout_chunk_size):
            indexes = outputs[start:start + readout_chunk_size]
            left = layout.evaluation_left[list(indexes)].to(sources.dtype)
            right = layout.evaluation_right[list(indexes)].to(sources.dtype)
            left_factor = torch.exp(-left[:, None, None, None] * decay[graph])
            right_factor = torch.exp(-right[:, None, None, None] * decay[graph])
            spectral = (left_factor[..., None] * forward[segment][None]
                        + right_factor[..., None] * backward[segment][None])
            chunks.append(_readout_reconstruct_chunk(spectral, vectors[graph])
                          if vectors is not None else spectral)
    return torch.cat(chunks, dim=0)

source_excerpts.source_segment:
def compare_model_step_v1(native_model: AnchorKernelModel,
                           compact_model: AnchorCompactActualBankModelV1,
                           native_bank: AnchorKernelBank,
                           compact_bank: CompactActualBankV1) -> dict:
    """One deterministic full-Q VJP and actively clipped matched AdamW step.

    Only private deep copies of models and feature inputs change. No training,
    ancestry labels, prediction score or checkpoint/early-stopping identity.
    """
    identity = _model_view_cell_identity_v2(native_model, native_bank, compact_bank)
    if (compact_model.geometry != identity["geometry"]
            or compact_model.coupling != identity["coupling"]):
        raise ValueError("Native/compact model geometry or coupling contract differs")
    identity = dict(identity, probe="full_model_VJPs_and_clipped_AdamW")
    left, right = copy.deepcopy(native_model), copy.deepcopy(compact_model)
    right.load_state_dict(left.state_dict(), strict=True)
    left.eval()
    right.eval()
    left_bank = replace(native_bank, bank=replace(native_bank.bank,
                        leaf_x=native_bank.bank.leaf_x.detach().clone().requires_grad_(True)))
    right_bank = replace(compact_bank,
                         leaf_x=compact_bank.leaf_x.detach().clone().requires_grad_(True))
    lc, rc = left.encode_context(left_bank), right.encode_context(right_bank)
    ll, rl = left.head(lc.targets), right.head(rc.targets)
    checks = {"logits_all_Q": comparison_v1(rl, ll),
              "final_anchors": comparison_v1(rc.anchors, lc.anchors),
              "final_targets": comparison_v1(rc.targets, lc.targets)}
    for i, (a, b) in enumerate(zip(lc.layers, rc.layers)):
        for name in ("anchors", "targets", "numerator", "mass", "sources", "mass_sources"):
            checks[f"layer{i}.{name}"] = comparison_v1(getattr(b, name), getattr(a, name))
        # Per-scale raw action is qualified separately from mixed masses.
        sources = torch.stack((a.sources, a.mass_sources), dim=-1)
        raw_left = anchor_kernel_action(native_bank.layout, native_bank.operators[left.geometry],
                                       sources, left.layers[i].rates, left.layers[i].damping,
                                       coupling=left.coupling)
        raw_right = anchor_spectral_compact_action_v1(
            compact_bank.layout, compact_bank.geometry, sources,
            left.layers[i].rates, left.layers[i].damping, coupling=left.coupling,
            readout_chunk_size=right.readout_chunk_size)
        checks[f"layer{i}.raw_per_scale"] = comparison_v1(raw_right, raw_left)
    lo, ro = optimizer_v1(left), optimizer_v1(right)
    qualification_objective_v1(ll, lc).backward()
    qualification_objective_v1(rl, rc).backward()
    checks["input_feature_VJP"] = comparison_v1(right_bank.leaf_x.grad,
                                                left_bank.bank.leaf_x.grad, gradient=True)
    lp, rp = dict(left.named_parameters()), dict(right.named_parameters())
    if lp.keys() != rp.keys() or left.state_dict().keys() != right.state_dict().keys():
        raise ValueError("Inherited parameter/state-dict identity changed")
    for name in lp:
        if lp[name].grad is None or rp[name].grad is None:
            raise ValueError("Missing expected model VJP: " + name)
        checks[name + ".VJP"] = comparison_v1(rp[name].grad, lp[name].grad, gradient=True)
    ln = torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(left.parameters(), 1., error_if_nonfinite=True)
    rn = torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(right.parameters(), 1., error_if_nonfinite=True)
    if not float(ln) > 1 or not float(rn) > 1:
        raise ValueError("Frozen objective did not exercise active gradient clipping")
    checks["preclip_norm"] = comparison_v1(rn, ln, gradient=True)
    # A failed parity must stop BEFORE optimizer mutation.
    if not all(x["passed"] for x in checks.values()):
        return dict(status="parity_failed_optimizer_not_run", checks=checks,
                    cell_identity=identity, all_Q_checked=True, labels_opened=False)
    lo.step()
    ro.step()
    for name in lp:
        checks[name + ".post_AdamW"] = comparison_v1(rp[name], lp[name], gradient=True)
        for key in ("step", "exp_avg", "exp_avg_sq"):
            checks[name + ".optimizer." + key] = comparison_v1(
                ro.state[rp[name]][key], lo.state[lp[name]][key], gradient=True)
    return dict(status="PASS" if all(x["passed"] for x in checks.values()) else
                "parity_failed_after_private_optimizer_step", checks=checks,
                cell_identity=identity, all_Q_checked=True, labels_opened=False,
                preclip_native_norm=float(ln), preclip_compact_norm=float(rn),
                input_models_modified=False)

def compare_action_VJPs_v1(model: AnchorKernelModel, native: AnchorKernelBank,
                           compact: CompactActualBankV1) -> dict:
    """Actual encoded first-layer q/r signal and raw rate/damping/mixture VJPs.

    Signals are detached and made independent VJP inputs. Fixed geometry is
    identical. All evaluation rows and all branches remain in the objective.
    """
    identity = _model_view_cell_identity_v2(model, native, compact)
    identity = dict(identity, probe="independent_signal_action_VJPs")
    geometry, coupling = identity["geometry"], identity["coupling"]
    if model.rate_parameterization != "log":
        raise ValueError("Frozen actual qualification uses native log-rate model")
    with torch.no_grad():
        h = model.encoder(native.bank.leaf_x, native.bank.query_cache.normalized_response)
        q = h[:, native.bank.query_cache.query_indices][native.layout.anchor_graph]
        r = h[:, native.bank.query_cache.reference_indices][native.layout.anchor_graph]
        layer = model.layers[0]
        initial = (layer.query_projection(q).tanh(), layer.reference_projection(r).tanh(),
                   layer.raw_coupling, layer.raw_damping, layer.mixture_logits)
    def execute(kind):
        query, reference, raw_rate, raw_damping, logits = tuple(
            x.detach().clone().requires_grad_(True) for x in initial)
        rates = layer.initial_coupling * raw_rate.exp()
        damping = layer.initial_damping * raw_damping.exp()
        cqr = native.operators[geometry].cqr[native.layout.anchor_graph]
        sources = query[:, None] - (cqr @ reference[:, None]) * rates[None, :, None, :]
        mass_sources = torch.ones_like(sources) - cqr.sum(-1)[..., None] * rates[None, :, None, :]
        bundle = torch.stack((sources, mass_sources), dim=-1)
        if kind == "native":
            raw = anchor_kernel_action(native.layout, native.operators[geometry],
                                       bundle, rates, damping, coupling=coupling)
        else:
            raw = anchor_spectral_compact_action_v1(compact.layout, compact.geometry,
                bundle, rates, damping, coupling=coupling, readout_chunk_size=128)
        mixed = (raw * logits.softmax(0)[None, :, None, :, None]).sum(1)
        numerator, mass = mixed.unbind(-1)
        if not bool(torch.isfinite(mass).all() & (mass > 0).all()):
            raise ValueError("All mixed row masses must remain finite and positive")
        normalized = numerator / mass
        weights = torch.linspace(-.7, .9, normalized.numel(), dtype=normalized.dtype,
                                 device=normalized.device).reshape_as(normalized)
        objective = (normalized * weights).mean() + .013 * mass.log().mean()
        inputs = (query, reference, raw_rate, raw_damping, logits)
        gradients = torch.autograd.grad(objective, inputs)
        return (raw, numerator, mass, normalized), gradients
    left, lg = execute("native")
    right, rg = execute("compact")
    checks = {name: comparison_v1(b, a) for name, a, b in zip(
        ("raw_per_scale", "numerator", "mass", "normalized_all_Q"), left, right)}
    for name, a, b in zip(("query_signal", "reference_signal", "raw_coupling",
                          "raw_damping", "mixture_logits"), lg, rg):
        checks[name + ".VJP"] = comparison_v1(b, a, gradient=True)
    return dict(status="PASS" if all(x["passed"] for x in checks.values()) else "FAIL",
                checks=checks, cell_identity=identity, all_Q_checked=True, labels_opened=False,
                input_model_modified=False)

def observe_live(launcher):
    """Read own live lease/title, driver context, precision and NVTOP each boundary."""
    import ctypes
    from .development_execution import deterministic_development_manifest
    from .native_argformer_exec import validate_lease, canonical_uuid
    lease = validate_lease()
    title = Path("/proc/self/cmdline").read_bytes().split(b"\0")[0].decode().strip()
    require(title == sealed.PROCESS_TITLE, "Root must set title before any CUDA context")
    policy = deterministic_development_manifest()
    require(torch.cuda.is_initialized(), "Root must qualify its own CUDA context first")
    require(torch.cuda.device_count() == 1 and torch.cuda.current_device() == 0,
            "Single own logical CUDA0 required")
    driver = ctypes.CDLL("libcuda.so.1")
    device = ctypes.c_int()
    require(driver.cuCtxGetDevice(ctypes.byref(device)) == 0, "No current CUDA driver context")
    class UUID(ctypes.Structure):
        _fields_ = [("bytes", ctypes.c_ubyte * 16)]
    value = UUID()
    driver.cuDeviceGetUuid.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(UUID), ctypes.c_int]
    require(driver.cuDeviceGetUuid(ctypes.byref(value), device) == 0,
            "Actual driver context UUID unavailable")
    import uuid
    actual_uuid = str(uuid.UUID(bytes=bytes(value.bytes)))
    require(actual_uuid == canonical_uuid(lease["visible_gpu_uuid"]), "Own driver UUID differs")
    nvtop_file = sealed.checked_file(launcher["nvtop_snapshot"], ROOT)
    admitted_snapshot = json.loads(nvtop_file.read_text())
    result = subprocess.run([str(ROOT / ".runtime/env/bin/nvtop"), "--snapshot"],
                            capture_output=True, check=True, timeout=30)
    snapshot = json.loads(result.stdout)
    # Root-issued raw snapshot is parsed separately from current observation.
    require(isinstance(admitted_snapshot, list), "Admitted raw NVTOP content missing")
    def own_rows(rows):
        return [(i, p) for i, gpu in enumerate(rows) for p in gpu.get("processes", [])
                if str(p.get("pid")) == str(os.getpid())]
    a, b = own_rows(admitted_snapshot), own_rows(snapshot)
    require(len(a) == len(b) == 1 and a[0][0] == b[0][0]
            and all(a[0][1].get(k) == b[0][1].get(k) for k in ("pid", "kind", "cmdline")),
            "Admitted raw NVTOP own PID/title/index differs from live")
    result = subprocess.run(["nvidia-smi", "--id=" + lease["visible_gpu_uuid"],
                             "--query-gpu=driver_version", "--format=csv,noheader"],
                            capture_output=True, text=True, check=True, timeout=15)
    executable = ROOT / ".runtime/env/bin/python"
    require(Path(sys.executable) == executable, "Exact project interpreter required")
    return dict(python=platform.python_version(), torch=torch.__version__,
        torch_cuda=torch.version.cuda, driver_version=result.stdout.strip(),
        python_executable=str(executable), python_executable_sha256=sealed.sha256_file(executable),
        actual_process_title=title, pid=os.getpid(), actual_context_uuid=actual_uuid,
        device="cuda", execution_policy=policy, logical_device_count=torch.cuda.device_count(),
        logical_device=torch.cuda.current_device(), lease=lease,
        nvtop_snapshot=snapshot, nvtop_snapshot_record=launcher["nvtop_snapshot"])

def perform_cell(admission, cell):
    sealed.recheck_admission_v1(admission.adapter)
    cpu, metadata = sealed.load_admitted_train_bank_v1(admission.adapter, cell["selection_index"])
    selected = admission.adapter.selected[cell["selection_index"]]
    require(all(metadata.get(k) == v for k, v in selected.items())
            and metadata.get("full_file_and_full_field_hash_checked") is True
            and metadata.get("labels_opened") is False and metadata.get("bank_modified") is False,
            "Performed loaded tile/integrity differs")
    if cell["coupling"] == "full":
        native, compact = sealed.qualification_models_v1(cell["geometry"], cell["state"])
        constructor = "qualification_models_v1"
    else:
        native, compact = sealed.qualification_direct_control_models_v2(cell["geometry"], cell["coupling"])
        constructor = "qualification_direct_control_models_v2"
    # The sealed CPU seed101 constructor and explicit stress state precede transfer.
    for model in (native, compact):
        require(model.hidden_dim == 32 and model.num_layers == 2 and model.input_dim == 47
                and model.rate_parameterization == "log" and model.num_classes == 4,
                "Frozen backbone changed")
        for layer in model.layers:
            for name, endpoints in (("raw_coupling", (-.7, .6)),
                                    ("raw_damping", (.4, -.3)),
                                    ("mixture_logits", (-.8, .7))):
                value = getattr(layer, name)
                expected = torch.zeros_like(value) if cell["state"] == "initial" else (
                    torch.linspace(*endpoints, 24).reshape(3, 8))
                require(torch.equal(value, expected), "Performed state differs")
    view = sealed.derive_compact_actual_bank_v1(cpu, cell["geometry"], cell["coupling"])
    device, dtype = ("cpu", torch.float64) if cell["device_condition"] == "cpu_float64" else (
                    "cuda:0", torch.float32)
    bank, view = cpu.to(device, dtype), view.to(device, dtype)
    native, compact = native.to(device=device, dtype=dtype), compact.to(device=device, dtype=dtype)
    if cell["probe"] == PROBES[0]:
        result = sealed.compare_action_VJPs_v1(native, bank, view)
    else:
        result = sealed.compare_model_step_v1(native, compact, bank, view)
    return dict(result, performed_request=cell, seeded_constructor=constructor,
                loaded_integrity=metadata)

def run_bootstrap(admission):
    permit, output = admission["permit"], admission["output"]
    prepare_scope(output)
    title = guard.apply_and_validate_title()
    torch, policy, runner = load_cuda_modules()
    require(not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
            and torch.__version__ == permit["runtime_expected"]["torch"]
            and torch.version.cuda == permit["runtime_expected"]["torch_cuda"], "Exact fresh Torch runtime required")
    require(policy.configure_deterministic_development() == policy.DETERMINISTIC_POLICY,
            "Exact frozen strict numerical policy required")
    adapter_config = validate_adapter_fields(permit["adapter_admission_fields"], runner.sealed)
    runner.check_owned_storage(output)
    recheck_inputs(admission, initial=True)
    initialize_context(torch)
    snapshot = subprocess.run([str(ROOT / ".runtime/env/bin/nvtop"), "--snapshot"],
                              capture_output=True, check=True, timeout=30)
    snapshot_record = write_evidence(output, "nvtop_initial.json", snapshot.stdout, raw=True)
    live = runner.observe_live({"nvtop_snapshot": snapshot_record})
    require(live["lease"] == admission["lease"] and live["pid"] == os.getpid()
            and live["actual_process_title"] == title == guard.PROCESS_TITLE
            and live["actual_context_uuid"] == admission["lease"]["canonical_uuid"]
            and live["logical_device_count"] == 1 and live["logical_device"] == 0
            and all(live[key] == value for key, value in permit["runtime_expected"].items()),
            "Actual own PID/title/UUID/runtime differs from root permit")
    project_devices = sorted({i for i, gpu in enumerate(live["nvtop_snapshot"])
        for process in gpu.get("processes", [])
        if process.get("cmdline", "").strip() == guard.PROCESS_TITLE})
    require(project_devices == permit["project_physical_gpus"], "Live project device inventory differs")
    source_map = dict(adapter_config["source_sha256"])
    source_map.update({"src/arggnn/anchor_compact_qualification_runner_v1.py":
        admission["config"]["source_sha256"]["src/arggnn/anchor_compact_qualification_runner_v1.py"],
        RUNNER_CONFIG["path"]: RUNNER_CONFIG["sha256"]})
    common = dict(status="active_root_admission", authorizer="root_agent", project_root=str(ROOT),
                  runner_config=RUNNER_CONFIG, issued_unix_seconds=time.time())
    binding = dict(bootstrap_source=permit["bootstrap_source"], bootstrap_config=admission["config_record"],
                   root_permit=admission["permit_record"], independent_bootstrap_review=permit["independent_bootstrap_review"],
                   pool_extension=permit["pool_extension"], experiment_admission=permit["experiment_admission"])
    runtime = dict(common, kind="root_compact_runner_runtime_v1", source_sha256=source_map,
                   **{key: live[key] for key in permit["runtime_expected"]},
                   actual_process_title=live["actual_process_title"], pid=live["pid"],
                   actual_context_uuid=live["actual_context_uuid"], device="cuda",
                   execution_policy=live["execution_policy"], bootstrap_execution=binding)
    launcher = dict(common, kind="root_compact_runner_launcher_v1", lease=live["lease"], pid=live["pid"],
        actual_context_uuid=live["actual_context_uuid"], title_before_cuda=title,
        title_before_cuda_verified=True, root_pool_runner_allowlist_integrated=True,
        launch_after_prior_pools_natural_drain=True, nvtop_snapshot=snapshot_record,
        nvtop_exit_code=0, nvtop_executable=str(ROOT / ".runtime/env/bin/nvtop"),
        project_physical_gpus=project_devices, bootstrap_execution=binding)
    storage = permit["storage_fields"]
    runner.validate_domains(runtime, storage, launcher, config_record=RUNNER_CONFIG,
        source_sha256=source_map, output=output, live=live, now=time.time(), initial=True)
    domains = {key: write_evidence(output, key + ".json", value) for key, value in (
        ("runtime_admission", runtime), ("storage_admission", storage), ("launcher_admission", launcher))}
    adapter = dict(permit["adapter_admission_fields"], **domains)
    adapter_record = write_evidence(output, "adapter_admission.json", adapter)
    root = dict(kind="root_compact_qualification_runner_v1_admission", status="active_root_admission",
        authorizer="root_agent", project_root=str(ROOT), runner_config=RUNNER_CONFIG,
        runner_source={"path": "src/arggnn/anchor_compact_qualification_runner_v1.py",
            "sha256": source_map["src/arggnn/anchor_compact_qualification_runner_v1.py"]},
        independent_runner_review=RUNNER_REVIEW, adapter_admission=adapter_record,
        output_scope=str(output), fit_allowed=False, truth_allowed=False, bootstrap_execution=binding, **domains)
    runner_record = write_evidence(output, "runner_admission.json", root)
    runner.check_owned_storage(output)
    recheck_inputs(admission)
    result = runner.main(["--config", RUNNER_CONFIG["path"], "--config-sha256", RUNNER_CONFIG["sha256"],
                          "--admission", runner_record["path"], "--admission-sha256", runner_record["sha256"]])
    recheck_inputs(admission)
    runner.check_owned_storage(output)
    return result
